name: stratless
description: Give your AI coding assistant a brief on who you are, read from your own history, so it stops making you feel stupid. Local, private, no account.
//: The npm page is where a stranger lands, and this package asks to read their entire
//1: conversation history. Without these three links it would ask for that trust while
//2: showing no source at all. The line count IS the argument — so point at the lines.
//dep: ZERO RUNTIME DEPENDENCIES, again (0.6.0). The local embedding engine is NOT a dependency:
//dep1: it arrives once, at `init`, after the person's yes — @stratless/engine (~3MB, pre-bundled
//dep2: WASM) plus the model weights (~34MB), into ~/.stratless, pinned by exact version and
//dep3: integrity hash in src/fetch.ts. `npx stratless` costs a stranger this package alone, and
//dep4: the mirror it runs needs no model. WASM on purpose — standard over speed: identical bits
//dep5: on every machine, so a runtime change is a versioned, announced rebuild, never silent drift.
